title: The Dow Market Happenings For Thursday, December 27, 2018
text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Thursday, December 27, 2018 Posted by admin on December 27th, Boeing (BA), IBM ten (10) Dow stocks with new intraday lows, however all closed higher by 3 to 6%.
 down -339 points.
Wednesday the Dow was up +1086.25 (+4.98%) at 22,878.45.
Year-to-date the Dow is down -7.45%.
There were 30 Dow stocks up Wednesday.
The Dow stock winners Wednesday were led by Nike (NKE) +7.21%, Apple (AAPL) +7.04%, Visa (V) +6.98%, Microsoft (MSFT) +6.83%, Boeing (BA) +6.72%, Caterpillar (CAT) +6.68%, Home Depot (HD) +6.41%, DowDuPont (HD) +6.41%, Chevron (CVX) +6.34% and Intel (INTC) +5.96%.
The Dow stock losers Wednesday were not to be found.
Looks like the end-of-year sellers want to take advantage of yesterdays gift.
European stocks are lower 1.3 cents at $2.297
Home Depot (HD)
Home Depot (HD) is down -11.21% year-to-date.
